name: How do I choose between a handyman and a general contractor for property repairs?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose between a handyman and a general contractor for property repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: A general contractor provides single-point oversight for multi-step projects, whereas an independent handyman usually focuses on isolated, single-day tasks. If your repair involves only minor surface tweaks, an individual handyman may suffice. However, if maintenance involves drywall repair tied to hidden water leaks, custom framing adjustments, or aging tile assemblies, a general contractor coordinates the required plumbing or electrical subcontractors while managing finish trades directly. This unified management eliminates scheduling conflicts between separate workers and ensures that framing, finishes, and underlying systems align smoothly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a general contractor when maintenance spans multiple trades, structural carpentry, or requires coordinated plumbing and electrical subcontractors.
